note: Alias enrichment for #دیابت. Found while publishing sharehub/share-13: a dentist typing «بیمار دیابتیک» — the most natural clinical phrasing — never reached #دیابت, because the concept only carried «diabetes», «مرض قند» and «بیماری قند». The adjectival forms tokenize as their own words (دیابتیک / دیابتی / diabetic are NOT stemmed to دیابت), so without them the query simply missed the concept. NOTE for future batches: `aliases` REPLACES the concept's list, it does not merge — so the three pre-existing aliases are repeated here on purpose. Aliases only; no new concept, no retagging.
